text_block_list.text:
Aiming first to gain name recognition and 
popularity in the Twinkle Series, Oguri 
Cap resolved to enter various races.

We arrived at the racetrack to participate 
in a race being held for an event, but—

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan! Long time no see~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wh...! Why is everyone here...!?

Following the surprised Oguri Cap's gaze, 
I see a lively, bustling group happily 
waving in our direction.

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, surprised ya, huh? The 'surprise' 
was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That really startled me... For a second, I 
thought I'd accidentally gone back home.
choice_data_list: Oguri Cap, could these people be...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies, I haven't introduced 
them yet. Everyone, these are folks from 
my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to introduce them to you all. 
This person is my Trainer, and—"

After a brief introduction, I was welcomed 
by a chorus of warm voices. Just as I'd 
heard beforehand, they're truly kind 
people.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, you came all this way to see me. 
Even though it was such a long journey...

text_block_list.name: Take-san
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, Ogri-chan's made her debut, so 
there's no way I could just stay cooped up 
in the countryside!"

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
Everrryone wanted to see Oguri-chan giving 
her all at the JRA, so we came to cheer 
you on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone... thank you.

As the folks from her hometown came up to 
talk to her one after another, Oguri Cap's 
expression softened considerably. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that Oguri Cap over there? You 
know, the one who was completely 
undefeated in Kasamatsu...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... But that was back in Kasamatsu, 
right? There's no way that'll fly in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, who do you think will 
win the next race? I'm putting my hopes on 
Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's gotta be Super Creek! I mean, 
think about it—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'll head over to get ready 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... Still, Oguri-chan... Are you 
gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if Oguri-chan doesn't mind, then 
I suppose it's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
Still, if anything unpleasant or painful 
happens, you can come home right away, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Take-san
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna cheer as loud as we can today! 
Just listen to our voices, alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... Thanks? Today is an exhibition 
race, but I hope you enjoy it.

After the people from her hometown saw her 
off, Oguri Cap wore a puzzled look the 
entire time. It seemed she didn't 
understand why they were worried about 
her.

So, I explained that it was likely because 
she heard heartless remarks from the 
crowd...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... So everyone was worried about me, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own way of thinking. So 
I didn't let it bother me, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. If things stay like this, I'll only 
end up making everyone worry.
choice_data_list:
If you win, all that chatter will 
disappear.

If you win, all that chatter will 
disappear, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That's why I'm going to run in 
lots of races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. I will definitely make them 
acknowledge me here... here in the 
Central."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First things first, I gotta win this race 
and put everyone's minds at ease.

True to her word, Oguri Cap broke away on 
the final stretch to claim a landslide 
victory, demonstrating her sheer 
superiority before the folks of her 
hometown!
